booking.howItWorks: Party packages are available any time during open play hours providing lanes are available. Contact us to reserve your lane and special pricing. A $20 pre-paid deposit is required to reserve your lane.

serviceCharge.note: A gratuity will be automatically added to all parties of $100 or more at 18%.

packages.name: Birthday Package
packages.description: Minimum of 6. $14.95 per child. Available any time during open play hours providing lanes are available.
includes: 1 hour of bowling and bowling shoes
Plates, napkins and cups available upon request
"Real Bowling Pin" for the birthday child
BoGo bowling game cards for all that are bowling

food.name: Build your own 16" pizza
food.description: Toppings $1.50 each: onion, green pepper, mushroom, black olive, sausage, bacon, pepperoni

food.name: Bavarian Pretzel

faq.q: Can we bring our own food or cake?
faq.a: Birthday cake or cupcakes are your responsibility. NO OTHER CARRY-INS PLEASE.
Bumpers are available for bowlers aged 12 and under.

faq.q: Is a deposit required for parties?
faq.a: A $20 pre-paid deposit is required to reserve your lane.
A gratuity will be automatically added to all parties of $100 or more at 18%.

faq.q: When can I book a party?
faq.a: Party packages are available any time during open play hours providing lanes are available. Please contact us to reserve your lane and special pricing.

faq.q: What are the bar & grill hours?
faq.a: Sunday–Tuesday closed; Wednesday and Thursday 4PM-10PM; Friday and Saturday 4PM-11PM.
